name: piston_push_minecart_two_pistons
description: Two pistons side by side, the second a block further east, push a minecart that straddles both lanes in the same tick. The first head shoves it the full 0.51 a piston may move an entity in a tick (it starts touching the head), so the second head's push, though it overlaps the cart by almost a block, is cut to nothing. On the next tick the first pushes 0.5 and the second gets the 0.01 left.
